howItWorks.title: How does it work?
howItWorks.step1Desc: Fill out the short form with your club details and preferred visit date.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Our team selects a suitable trained mentor and confirms the date with you.
howItWorks.step3Desc: The mentor visits your club for an interactive session on the chosen topic.

items.question: How much does the visit cost?
items.answer: The visit is completely free. The program is funded by the Bulgarian Fund for Women.

items.question: How long does a session last?
items.answer: A standard session is about 60-90 minutes, including time for questions and discussion.

items.question: Who can request a visit?
items.answer: Any senior club, community center, or organization for elderly people in Bulgaria can submit a request.

items.question: What topics are covered?
items.answer: We offer topics such as recognizing misinformation, voter rights, how the election process works, and others upon request.

items.question: How are the mentors prepared?
items.answer: Mentors undergo special training from the PENSA Foundation team and work with verified materials and methodologies.

items.question: Can I track my request status?
items.answer: Yes, after submitting a request you receive a tracking code that you can use to monitor the status of your request.

resources.fakeNewsDesc: Materials and modules for identifying fake news and misinformation.
resources.voterRightsDesc: Information about voter rights, registration, and participation in elections.
resources.electionProcessDesc: A guide to understanding the election process, from registration to vote counting.
resources.guidePrepText: Review the topic materials before each visit. Prepare simple, clear examples that resonate with the audience. Bring printed handouts when possible.
resources.guideConductText: Start with introductions and set a friendly tone. Encourage questions and discussions. Use real-world examples. Keep the session interactive — avoid long lectures.
resources.guideAfterText: Submit your feedback through the History tab. Note any challenges or special requests for the team. Share any observations that could improve future visits.
resources.contactDesc: For questions, urgent issues, or suggestions, reach out to the PENSA team.
